_comment: Public upstream resource manifest. Some datasets require approved access; source code does not redistribute their data.

benches.note: run_mmau_official.py: load_dataset(split=test_mini) reads HF_HOME hub cache
lmms-eval task video_mmmu_comprehension (videos ship inside the dataset repo)
lmms-eval task videomme_v2. utils.py hard-requires the 800 source .mp4 pre-extracted to HF_HOME/<cache_dir>/{video_id}.mp4 (see post-step).
2853-row public mirror (matches our contam-ref). run_jointav_official.py wants JOINTAV_DATA=<dir>/jointavbench.json + videos/<qid>.mp4 (see post-step).
Approved upstream snapshot: data.parquet and videos/. Converter validates grouped QA schema and media before scoring.

SWE-bench Multimodal (the code/SWE dimension; scored by REAL resolved rate, not string match). The dataset download is all prepare_data.sh does; grading additionally needs (a) a python venv with swebench==5.0.2 at $SWE_WORK/venv, (b) outbound HTTPS to a container registry + blob mirror (MMSWE_REGISTRY_API / MMSWE_BLOB_MIRROR) and to each instance's screenshot host, and (c) unshare+chroot capability in the eval container. See src/eval/tasks/mmswe/dlc_native_grade.py.
